account.location.title: Location precision
account.location.intro: Winkly uses your location to show how far away people are. Choose how precise that is. Either way, your raw GPS position is never stored, and other people only ever see a rounded distance — never your coordinates.
account.location.approximate.title: Approximate
account.location.approximate.subtitle: Recommended. Your location is rounded to roughly a {{size}} area before it’s stored — enough for distance matching, but it never reveals where you actually are.
account.location.precise.title: Precise
account.location.precise.subtitle: More accurate distances. Your location is still rounded (to about {{size}}) and your exact GPS position is never stored or shared with anyone.
account.location.footnote: Switching to Approximate takes effect immediately. Switching to Precise applies the next time your location refreshes.
